subject: Acceptance timeline, billing zipper plan and commitment top-up
messages:
From: Sarah Tang <sarah.tang@greengrid.ai>

Cc: procurement@greengrid.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Alignment on PO acceptance and invoice cadence for Q4 uplift

Hi Ben / Kimberly,

Quick ask from procurement — we need to accelerate the Q4 commit top-up we discussed on the call. Legal and finance want a clear acceptance checklist (what evidence you need, timing windows) and confirmation that Redwood can split the invoice across two fiscal months (we call that a "zipper" billing pattern) because our FY closes Oct 15 and we need part of the spend in Q3.

Two specific questions:
- Can Redwood accept a PO signed by our procurement team and still do a staged activation (acceptance window) so we can start using capacity immediately?
- What exact artifacts do you need for acceptance (usage tests, test-bed results, SLA signoff, signed PO)?

If you send a short checklist and a preferred DocuSign flow, I can get procurement/finance to greenlight the PO this week.

Thanks,
Sarah Tang
Sr. Procurement Manager
GreenGrid AI

Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Alignment on PO acceptance and invoice cadence for Q4 uplift

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask.

Short answer: yes, we can support a signed PO + staged activation and we can do a two-tranche invoicing approach (zipper billing) with appropriate PO references. Below is the acceptance checklist we use for marketplace/private-offer migrations; I'll attach the working spreadsheet for you to share with finance.

Acceptance checklist (high level):
- Signed PO that references account ID: GG-ACCT-0042 (we can accept the scan for initial activation; DocuSign preferred for final)
- Evidence bundle: initial smoke test logs (3 sample jobs), usage baseline report (first 48 hours)
- Compliance confirmation: billing entity and VAT/tax info (we need official billing entity name and tax ID)
- SLA acknowledgement: confirm target latency tier and any custom fallbacks
- Activation window: we require a 5-business-day acceptance window to verify KV/cache behavior and throughput at the agreed profile

Proposed timeline if you can sign this week: 
- Mon/Tue: GreenGrid issues signed PO (scan to start activation)
- Wed: Redwood performs staged activation and initial smoke tests
- Following Mon (5 business days): final acceptance sign-off and DocuSign completes legal handoff

I'll attach the acceptance-checklist.xlsx (stub) and we can iterate. Priyom — looping you for marketplace/DocuSign flow and whether we can route invoices into two fiscal tranches.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acceptance-checklist.xlsx]

Subject: Re: Alignment on PO acceptance and invoice cadence for Q4 uplift

Hi team — quick procurement/ops note from my side.

We can support the zipper (staggered) invoice approach on the marketplace private-offer, but there are a few required fields on the PO so our billing engine can map charges correctly:
- Exact billing entity name and tax ID (as Ben noted)
- PO number that includes the deal id (please use: RG-2027-GG-0012)
- Desired split percentages and target invoice dates (we will align to your fiscal cut: e.g., 60% invoice dated Sep 30, 40% invoice dated Oct 15)

DocuSign flow: we have an internal PowerForm for private offers. If you attach a signed PDF PO we can ingest and start activation immediately; final DocuSign completion will be required to close the legal loop. I attached a PO template with the exact fields we need.

Operational caveats: staged activation will enable usage immediately but acceptance tests must be performed in the activation window otherwise final acceptance can be delayed and billing may pause. Ben, please confirm whether we need a canary model variant for the initial smoke tests (recommended for large capacity top-ups).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_template_GG.pdf]
